headline.purpose: Responsive primary headings set in the self-hosted display face.

title.purpose: Account, checkout, and section headings in the self-hosted display face.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase codes and compact metadata.

motion.name: record-band-print
motion.purpose: One restrained entrance on the five-part catalogue stripe; reduced-motion users receive the same visible final state.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast action for account and checkout steps.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 48px; width: 100%; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid #101216; padding: 12px 18px; color: #f4f0e6; background: #101216; cursor: pointer; font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .12em; text-align: center; transition: background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { color: #101216; background: #e7a13a; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e7a13a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: .65; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled account field with a square, bordered input.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; margin: 16px 0; color: #24231f; font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 44px; margin-top: 6px; border: 1px solid #aaa79e; border-radius: 0; padding: 0 12px; color: #101216; background: #fffefa; font: inherit; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e7a13a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-input:disabled { color: #5a5851; background: #e9e5db; }

components.name: Amount Field
components.description: Editable USD amount with aligned tabular numerals.
components.css: .ds-amount-label { display: block; color: #24231f; font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-amount { display: flex; align-items: center; margin-top: 6px; border: 1px solid #aaa79e; background: #fffefa; } .ds-amount > span { padding-left: 13px; color: #55534d; font-size: 16px; } .ds-amount input { width: 100%; height: 46px; margin: 0; border: 0; padding: 0 12px; color: #101216; background: transparent; font: inherit; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-amount input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e7a13a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Product Record
components.description: Single catalog item separated from the dark shell by a muted border.
components.html:
TEST-001

TEST PRODUCT

A single sample product.

Default amount $10.00

BUY
components.css: .ds-record { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 90px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 24px; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #54565a; padding: 22px; color: #f4f0e6; background: #17191d; font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-id { color: #e7a13a; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-record h3 { margin: 0 0 5px; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; } .ds-record p { margin: 0; color: #c5c1b8; font-size: 14px; } .ds-record .ds-price { margin-top: 8px; color: #78c5b7; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-buy { min-width: 112px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid #101216; color: #f4f0e6; background: #101216; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; } .ds-buy:hover { color: #101216; background: #e7a13a; } .ds-buy:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e7a13a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Account Tabs
components.description: Two conventional text tabs switch between sign-in and account creation.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 22px; margin-top: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c9c4b8; font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { margin-bottom: -1px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; padding: 0 0 10px; color: #55534d; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tab-active { color: #101216; border-bottom-color: #e7a13a; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e7a13a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Site Header
components.description: Compact wordmark and local status or return link above each task.
components.html: TEST STORE / RECORDSLOCAL TEST
components.css: .ds-header { min-height: 78px; padding: 14px 28px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #44464b; color: #f4f0e6; font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { color: #f4f0e6; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .14em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark span { color: #c5c1b8; font-weight: 500; } .ds-status { color: #78c5b7; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .12em; }

components.name: Record Code
components.description: Compact identifier for account, catalog, or payment context.
components.css: .ds-code { margin: 0; color: #e7a13a; font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .17em; } .ds-code span { padding: 0 4px; color: #78c5b7; }

components.name: Record Stripe
components.description: Five compact color bands with a single reduced-motion-aware print-in entrance.
components.css: .ds-stripe { display: flex; gap: 4px; width: 220px; height: 9px; } .ds-stripe i { flex: 1; background: #78c5b7; transform-origin: left center; animation: ds-record-band-print 560ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; } .ds-stripe i:nth-child(2) { flex: 1.6; background: #e7a13a; animation-delay: 35ms; } .ds-stripe i:nth-child(3) { flex: .5; background: #f4f0e6; animation-delay: 70ms; } .ds-stripe i:nth-child(4) { flex: 1.3; background: #78c5b7; animation-delay: 105ms; } .ds-stripe i:nth-child(5) { flex: .75; background: #ad5845; animation-delay: 140ms; } @keyframes ds-record-band-print { from { transform: scaleX(.72); filter: saturate(.72); } to { transform: scaleX(1); filter: saturate(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stripe i { animation-duration: .01ms; animation-delay: 0ms; } }

narrative.overview:
The Numbered Record Catalogue treats an account, the single test item, and its payment as precise records. Matte ink and warm paper establish the working surface; orange and teal act as printed marks, while compact codes keep the sequence legible. The result is a focused utility, not a general merchandise storefront.

Self-hosted IBM Plex Sans headings give the catalogue a compact voice; familiar Segoe UI keeps controls and body copy task-first. Paper panels sit squarely against the dark shell, and prices use tabular numerals. The account and confirmation flow leads to PRODUCTS, then a separate Stripe test checkout with an editable amount.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-dark shell with warm-paper work surfaces.
Amber and teal record markings, compact codes, and tabular price figures.
Self-hosted IBM Plex Sans headings with familiar Segoe UI controls and body copy.
Square, bordered panels and familiar web form controls.

rules.name: The Ink-and-Paper Rule
rules.body: Keep ink and warm paper as the principal surfaces; use amber and teal as compact record marks, reserving their deeper variants for paper-panel text.

rules.name: The Local Headline Rule
rules.body: Bundle IBM Plex Sans for headings; keep Segoe UI for body copy and conventional controls.

rules.name: The Tabular Amount Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for displayed prices and amounts; the implementation does not use a separate monospaced typeface.

dos: Do use ink and warm paper as the primary surface contrast, with amber and teal for concise record marks.
Do keep amounts aligned with tabular numerals and preserve the square, bordered control language.
Do bundle IBM Plex Sans for headings and keep Segoe UI for body and control copy.
Do retain clear keyboard focus outlines on interactive controls.
Do theme text carets and scrollbars from the palette, and respect reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't turn the single test-item catalogue into a dense multi-product storefront.
Don't introduce rounded panel or field corners, shadows, or a separate mono face as if they were established patterns.
Don't replace the bundled heading face with an unbundled system display font.
Don't use the bright accent colors as long-form body-text colors.
